note.text: Safety rarely fails because nobody cared about it; it fails because it lived outside the normal rhythm of building, bolted on as a final review instead of baked into the weekly cadence. Teams that treat safety checks like standups, not like courtroom hearings, catch problems while they're still cheap to fix. The fix is organizational before it's technical: put the review inside the loop, not at the end of it.
